plan: Define Workspace class with __init__ deep-copying data and validating structure.
Implement helper methods for finding items, validating containers, and computing word counts.
Implement total_word_count recursively summing note words and reference word_count.
Implement unresolved_markers by collecting markers from notes and references, deduplicating and sorting.
Implement outline recursively generating indented lines.
Implement move with validation and deep-copy rollback on failure.
Write tests using unittest to verify all contract requirements.
mechanisms: Deep copy input data in __init__ to isolate internal state.
Recursive traversal for word count, markers, and outline.
Validation checks before mutation; use deep copy of original data for rollback.
Use regex \b\w+\b for word counting and [[?identifier]] for markers.
Use set for unique markers then sort.
Use index handling with None meaning append.
